description: This file provides extension properties for the AnyCodable type to convert its underlying value into various primitive or collection types, such as String, Bool, Int, Double, Dictionary, and Array, as well as a method to obtain a Foundation-compatible representation of the value.

methods.name: stringValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a String if possible.

methods.name: boolValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Bool if possible, handling NSNumber with boolean type.

methods.name: intValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an Int if possible, converting from NSNumber or numeric types.

methods.name: doubleValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Double if possible, converting from Int, NSNumber, or Double.

methods.name: dictionaryValue
methods.description: Returns the value as a Dictionary<String, AnyCodable> if possible, handling multiple underlying representations.

methods.name: arrayValue
methods.description: Returns the value as an Array<AnyCodable> if possible, handling various underlying representations.

methods.name: foundationValue
methods.description: Provides a Foundation-compatible representation of the underlying value, recursively converting collections.
